description: Defines the interface for the Starboard Player module, including enums, structs, and function declarations for media playback control, state management, and configuration.

methods.name: SbPlayerCreate
methods.description: Creates a media player instance with specified parameters and callbacks.

methods.name: SbPlayerDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a player instance and frees resources.

methods.name: SbPlayerSeek
methods.description: Seeks the player to a specified timestamp, resetting the decoder pipeline.

methods.name: SbPlayerWriteSamples
methods.description: Writes media samples to the player's input stream.

methods.name: SbPlayerWriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Marks the end of the media stream for a specific media type.

methods.name: SbPlayerSetBounds
methods.description: Sets the display bounds for the player.

methods.name: SbPlayerSetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Adjusts the playback speed of the player.

methods.name: SbPlayerSetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level of the player.

methods.name: SbPlayerGetCurrentFrame
methods.description: Returns the current video frame as a decode target.
